### Villanelle: The Cycle of Belief

In shadows deep, the whispers softly call,  
With every chant, the mind begins to bend,  
A sacred truth awaits beyond the wall.  

The first embrace, a gathering of all,  
In circles tight, they share their hearts to mend,  
In shadows deep, the whispers softly call.  

Through rituals of fire, they stand tall,  
The flames ignite, their doubts begin to end,  
A sacred truth awaits beyond the wall.  

With every pledge, they rise and then they fall,  
Each vow a thread, their spirits to suspend,  
In shadows deep, the whispers softly call.  

The world outside, a distant, fading thrall,  
They sever ties, their pasts they must transcend,  
A sacred truth awaits beyond the wall.  

At last, they kneel, in reverence enthralled,  
The self dissolves, the new begins to blend,  
In shadows deep, the whispers softly call,  
A sacred truth awaits beyond the wall.
